name: personal-ai

personal-foundation.description: Personal global reasoning, research, document and collaboration skills.

web-engineering.description: React/Next and Node/NestJS web engineering, quality, browser tests and API integrations.

design-studio.description: Design exploration, redesign, page transitions, complex motion, SVG illustration/animation and HTML publications.

research-documents.description: Evidence-based research, extraction and editable document creation.

marketing-growth.description: Positioning, campaigns, content, experimentation and growth operations.

engineering-operations.description: Architecture, data integrity, security, observability and release operations.

personal-workbench.description: Shared craft workflows with executable browser, vector, office and Markdown tools; configure existing runtimes locally.

runtime_policy: Install selected target configuration without installing applications, dependencies, logging in, or starting MCP servers. Verify activation in the selected client.

delegation.strategy: Use the selected host agent and available bounded workers. Honor explicit provider choices; the initiating agent owns integration and verification.
